decisions.reason: A compact rotating-skip dumper builds directly on the firm's decades of experience with construction and site vehicles, so it can read early market feedback and refine the product with its existing engineering knowledge.
An articulated construction dumper fits the firm's core competence in rugged specialized vehicles and its service network, giving high absorptive capacity to improve it after launch.

An underground mine rescue vehicle extends the firm's established underground expertise into a niche with demanding but well-understood customer requirements, which justifies continued learning despite small volumes.

A compact telescopic loader line draws on the firm's lifting and construction machinery know-how, and the several models show a committed investment it can refine through customer-specific adaptation.
